finding.expected: Transported FAILURE facts preserve the compact deterministic diagnostics already available at the failing boundary, sufficient for ChatGPT to identify the observed failure without default raw-log upload. Raw executor or verification logs remain local unless later evidence escalation is required.
finding.issue: FAILURE transport does not preserve minimum-sufficient deterministic diagnostics for ChatGPT diagnosis. Executor failures are reduced to the text before the first colon, which can discard the actionable boundary fact such as a timeout reason. Runtime verification failures likewise do not expose their already-captured compact command, exit-code, and summary facts through the transported FAILURE artifact. This can still require Human relay of local diagnostics.
